informal_statement: Euclidean area of either original exterior cap.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At FourArcCandidate.lean:45-49, the source contract is `def capArea : ℝ := (candidate.alpha - sin candidate.alpha * cos candidate.alpha) / candidate.h ^ 2`. The candidate constructor has 0 < h <= 1 and 0 < alpha < pi/2. CMV incidence additionally means lambda > 1 and lambda*cos(alpha) = h. These conditions are not a hidden minimality or strict-improvement assumption.
